title: Great Tapastour in Sevilla
text: Had a great experience with our Alfonso. The food was amazing and the same goes for the tour and the stories that they told us about Sevilla. All the bars were well chosen and you really get a good Sevilla experience.
author: fabianvG2144MJ

title: Sevilla Tapas Tour.  Yum!
text:
Our tour was as comfortable as a visit with long time friends.  It was an enjoyable evening learning about local history while sampling delicious local fare.

Muchas Garcias Alfonso!
author: Q6643VLjeffreyh

title: Seville sights for the belly
text: A tasty and informative walking and eating tour through parts of Seville that we might not have otherwise seen. Alfonso was an engaging and attentive guide that I would recommend for those visiting the city.
author: timons506

title: Highlight of our trip
text: Excellent trip with excellent company. Samuel was the perfect host and made our trip (and we packed a lot in!) Highly recommend if you want to immerse yourself into the local cuisine and culture.
author: TCrossy96

title: Fantastic experience of Seville!
text: We had a fantastic tour today with Samuel. The tour absolutely exceeded our expectations, everything about it was 5/5. Samuel was an excellent tour guide and we learnt so much about Seville - from culture, history, food & drinks and he provided great recommendations and we felt we really experienced the city. The tour was great value for money - when it is recommended to come hungry - come hungry!! We ate far more than we anticipated and also had more drinks than expected too! Everything was delicious!! We'd recommend the tour to anyone and do it again in a heartbeat! Thanks Samuel!!
author: Megan271198

title: Highly recommended!
text: Great locally guided tapas tour with delicious culinary tapas! For us as pescatarians, there were great alternatives at every spot. Worth every cent of the money. Alfonso was a great guide and, in addition to the magnificent locations, also gave us a lot of input about Seville.
author: Lea_S

title: Fabulous & highly recommend if in Seville
text: Alphonso was a fabulous tour guide, very knowledgeable, friendly, didn’t rush us through & very engaging with everyone in the group.  The food was amazing & a wonderful selection of local dishes (& drinks) & Alphonso explained every dish, how it was made & the significance of it. Meeting point was easy to find, tour was relaxed.  Had a wonderful time & would highly recommend everyone visiting Seville to do this tour.
author: shazzd65

title: Delicious local tapas & info about the city
text: We had a wonderful tapas tour with Alfonso through Seville. All the spots were great and we were able to get meatless alternatives (vegetarian or with fish) everywhere. I can 100% recommend the tour.
author: leeea1994

title: Highlight in Seville
text:
Alfonso was a great guide, we enjoyed the tour very much and had an incredible amount of fun 😊
Many thanks for that!
